description:
Weighted Male Confidence Index (0-100) and the five domain scores (each 0-20) for Australian men,
    optionally split by a demographic (age_group, state, region, income, education, employment,
    household, housing, sexuality, or a single-choice question id such as Q15).

    Args:
        domain: optional one of finances_career, health_wellbeing, relationships, cultural_identity,
            self_perception_direction (default: index plus all domains).
        by: optional split variable.
name: mci_scores
title: Male Confidence Index: scores
